decisions.reason: Ending this freelancer's contract does not change the team's submission channels, deadlines, or planned Notion workflow.
The contract termination does not resolve or modify the applicable clip-duration rules.
The source message does not change which source footage is permitted or required for clips.
Ending the contract does not alter the standing standard that clips deliver complete, standalone teaching moments.
The source concerns termination after hiring and does not modify the historical qualification method or its success criteria.
The contract termination does not change the caption color, font, effects, lettering, or positioning standards.
The source message does not modify the clean and simple editing standard.
The same message directly establishes and reports failure of the communication expectation, while the expectation remains a standard for clippers rather than being removed with the approval gate.
